source_title: MEDKids Bladder starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
educational_content: The bladder is a stretchy bag that holds urine. The kidneys make urine. Urine flows from the kidneys down to the bladder. The bladder stretches as it fills up. A full bladder tells us it is time for the toilet.
learning_objectives: The bladder stretches as it fills up.

forbidden_claims.claim: Holding your pee for a long time is healthy
